newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on spot expiry.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher on spot expiry.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Monday, after the spot November futures contract expired at higher levels, traders said.
The spot November expired at noon at 136.5 yen per kg, up 4.2 yen from last Friday. Deliveries amounted to 700 lots.
Other prices ranged from 2.5 to 4.0 yen higher, with the benchmark April ending up 2.8 yen at 145.3 yen.
"Short-covering gathered force, encouraged by the high expiry price. Prices could edge up this week after benchmark April broke above resistance at 145 yen," one trader said.
